lines.t: They told me what I could touch was real…
What I could measure was all there is…
But the veil tore back.
The world did not get bigger—
I finally saw how small it was.
YahuShua…
The Kingdom is within.
I was raised in the dust with a clock on my wrist,
Chasin’ every little thing that the world said exists.
Cash in the account, gas in the ride,
Smile for the camera, pain kept inside.
Three dimensions, four walls, five senses trained,
Tryna make a whole life from a temporary frame.
Then the Word came down like a blade through fog,
Cut the cord from the lie, put fear in the dog.
I saw cities glow, saw the neon lie,
Saw men worship screens while their souls ran dry.
Saw bodies get old, saw graveyards fill,
Saw the proud talk loud, but they can’t stand still.
They say, “This is all,” but their eyes look dead,
Got a thousand distractions and no daily bread.
They can map the stars, put a probe in space,
But still can’t explain why they hate their face.
Then YahuShua spoke where the noise got thin,
Said, “The Kingdom of God is within.”
Not in the bricks, not a man-made name,
Not a holy-looking suit or religious game.
Inward throne, outward fruit,
Deep roots first, then a life with proof.
Every thought on trial, every idol exposed,
Every hidden room where the old self froze.
When the veil gets lifted, you can’t unsee,
The flesh got limits, but the Spirit breathes.
The storm ain’t proof that the King ain’t near,
Sometimes the thunder makes the truth more clear.
The 3D bends around the unseen flame,
The Kingdom within got authority in His name.
YahuShua reigns, let the old world shake,
Every trial in the flesh got a soul at stake.
I’m awake in the storm, I’m alive in the fire,
Not my will, Father—Your desire.
Galaxy twist, but Your throne don’t spin,
The whole world outside, but the Kingdom within.
Sovereign YaHuWaH, I don’t hold the pen,
I don’t own tomorrow, I don’t know the end.
I don’t summon angels with a phrase or a vibe,
I don’t bend the universe ‘cause I feel alive.
That new-age nonsense got men playin’ god,
Manifesting delusion while they dodge the rod.
I ain’t the Creator, I am clay in His hand,
And the Potter ain’t confused by the cracks in the land.
So when tribulation hit and it ripped my plans,
When I lost my grip and I couldn’t understand,
When the bills got heavy, when my body got weak,
When the night got long and I forgot how to speak,
I learned faith ain’t vibes and it ain’t a mood,
It’s obedience when the flesh wants food.
It’s forgiveness when revenge taste sweet,
It’s standin’ in truth when your knees go weak.
Pressure made visible what was hid in me,
Every wound, every pride, every secret enemy.
I thought I was strong till the furnace came,
Then the dross rose up with its ugly name.
Anger, fear, lust, control, escape,
Old dead habits wearing new fresh shapes.
But the King moved in where the darkness hid,
Turned a prison-cell heart to a place He lived.
The cross ain’t jewelry, the cross ain’t style,
It kills the old man mile by mile.
You want resurrection? Then die to the lie.
You want to see clearly? Then let pride die.
The 3D bends around the unseen flame,
The Kingdom within got authority in His name.
YahuShua reigns, let the old world shake,
Every trial in the flesh got a soul at stake.
I’m awake in the storm, I’m alive in the fire,
Not my will, Father—Your desire.
Galaxy twist, but Your throne don’t spin,
The whole world outside, but the Kingdom within.
Zoom out—Milky Way, black void, blue sphere,
Then zoom in—one man still ruled by fear.
Can’t hide in a theory, can’t flex a revelation,
If your home stay chaos, that ain’t transformation.
You can talk about dimensions, spirits, and light,
But do you love when you lose? Do you pray in the night?
Do you honor your word when the cost gets real?
Do you kneel when the Father says, “Be still”?
Kingdom within gotta leave a trace,
In the way you forgive, in the way you face
That wound from your father, that scar from the past,
That poison you fed just to numb it fast.
No cosmic escape from the work down here,
No psychedelic shortcut through grief and fear.
He meets you in truth, not fantasy smoke,
He breaks the chain where the old heart broke.
I walk through the grocery store, traffic, rent,
Still feel the Spirit in the common event.
In a crying child, in a sleepless night,
In the choice to do wrong or walk upright.
This dirt-world pressure got purpose and weight,
Every moment is a door, every choice a gate.
The invisible Kingdom is not make-believe,
It’s the life that appears when you truly believe.
[Bridge]
I saw the stars, but I feared the Maker.
I loved the signs, but ignored the Giver.
I chased the mystery, then missed the King…
